feat: YearKey rules, so a year depending on more than the turn is worked out again when that changes (#1)

0.1.5 kept whether a registry has any `YearKey` rules on each `Year`, as a transient `_keyState`. core-game's `Game.inject` gives a rebuilt entity only the collaborators it knows, so a rebuilt `Year` was left without it and `Game.inject` refused it (web-renderer's `test:inject`: "Game.inject left Year._keyState undefined"). The state is now looked up from the registry each time a key is made, a WeakMap lookup, and `Year`'s transient fields are those of 0.1.4 again. The constructor still makes the registry's one listener.
